;Armed conflicts and attacks
*Aftermath of the [[2017 Barcelona attacks]]
**[[Catalonia|Catalan]] [[Mossos d'Esquadra|police]] in the coastal town of [[Cambrils]] kill five suspected terrorists in a counter-terror operation to stop a second [[vehicle ramming attack|van attack]]. The police reported the attackers were wearing explosive vests, however they were later discovered to be fakes. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-40971004 (BBC)]
*[[2017 Turku stabbing]]
**At least two people are reportedly killed, and several others wounded in a stabbing in [[Turku]], [[Finland]]. Police said they arrested one person after a shootout and had launched a manhunt for other possible attackers. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-finland-stabbing-idUSKCN1AY1IS (Reuters)] [http://www.hs.fi/kotimaa/art-2000005331688.html (HS)]

;Arts and culture
*[[Removal of Confederate monuments and memorials|Removal of monuments and memorials]]
**The 145-year-old [[Roger B. Taney Monument (Annapolis, Maryland)|Roger B. Taney Monument]] outside [[Maryland State House]] in [[Annapolis, Maryland]], is removed overnight by authorities. Maryland Governor [[Larry Hogan]] called on Wednesday for the monument to be taken down immediately. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-protests-statues-idUSKCN1AY0UC (Reuters)]
*[[Repatriation (cultural heritage)|Repatriation of cultural heritage]]
**Two [[Joseon|Joseon Dynasty-era]] [[Seal (East Asia)#Korean usage|royal seals]] which were [[Repatriation (cultural heritage)|repatriated]] last July from the U.S. after being [[Looting|illegally taken out]] by an American soldier during the [[Korean War]], are on exhibit at the [[National Palace Museum of Korea]]. [http://www.koreatimes.co.kr/www/culture/2017/08/317_234987.html (''The Korea Times'')]

;Business and economy
*[[McDonald's]]
**Workers at two British [[McDonald's|McDonald's restaurants]] overwhelmingly vote to authorize a strike  over working conditions and the use of zero-hour contracts, which would be the first such labor action against the [[Fast food restaurant|fast-food]] chain in the U.K. [https://www.theguardian.com/business/2017/aug/18/mcdonalds-employees-vote-to-strike-over-pay-and-zero-hours-concerns (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2017-08-18/staff-at-two-u-k-mcdonald-s-restaurants-vote-for-first-strike (Bloomberg)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[August 2017 Nepal and India floods]]
**Flooding in South Asia has displaced tens of thousands of people and resulted in an estimated 500 deaths across [[India]], [[Bangladesh]], and [[Nepal]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-40975232 (BBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Political appointments of the first Trump administration|Political appointments by Donald Trump]]
**[[Steve Bannon]] resigns as [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s [[White House Chief Strategist]]. [http://abcnews.go.com/Politics/steve-bannon-white-house-chief-strategist/story?id=49295772 (ABC News)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2017/08/18/us/politics/steve-bannon-trump-white-house.html (''The New York Times'')]
**[[Carl Icahn]] steps down as special advisor to the [[President of the United States|President]]. [http://money.cnn.com/2017/08/18/news/donald-trump-carl-icahn/index.html (CNN)]
**All 17 members of the [[President's Committee on the Arts and Humanities]], including actor [[Kal Penn]] and artist [[Chuck Close]], resign. [http://www.miamiherald.com/entertainment/celebrities/article167952232.html (AP via ''Miami Herald'')] [http://www.indiawest.com/news/global_indian/kal-penn-jhumpa-lahiri-among-members-who-resign-from-trump/article_a23e4540-844f-11e7-9798-3be4036534a2.html (''India-West'')] [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2017/08/18/Presidential-arts-committee-resigns-en-masse-after-Charlottesville/6441503096571/ (UPI)]
*[[2017 Venezuelan constitutional crisis]]
**The controversial [[2017 Constituent Assembly of Venezuela|National Constituent Assembly]] votes unanimously to assume the powers of the opposition-led [[National Assembly (Venezuela)|National Assembly]] of [[Venezuela]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-40983115 (BBC)]
